title: What Does an Optometrist Do?
description: Follow a real optometrist through a complete working day in this episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks.in. Our host and Dr. Meera walk through three very different patients, from a short-sighted student to a routine check that uncovers hidden diabetes, revealing exactly what an optometrist does from the first history question to the final prescription, and why this profession is far more than checking eyesight.
